pages.text: A coordinate frame gives meaning to $(thing)right$(), $(thing)up$(), and $(thing)forward$() relative to an observer.$(br2)MathMod's horizontal player frame follows yaw while ignoring pitch, so a local forward vector stays level even when the player looks vertically.

pages.title: Typed Composition
pages.text: $(thing)player_frame$(): Player -> Frame$(br)$(thing)transform_local_vector$(): Frame x Vector3 -> Vector3$(br2)The local vector components are ordered (right, up, forward). The transformation is pure computation; only the final Push Self rune changes the world.

pages.title: In The Laboratory
pages.text: The Geometry group includes Right Basis Vector, Forward Basis Vector, and Oblique Basis Vector. Their related axis glyphs share one origin while each arrow identifies its direction.$(br2)Add one, then add Push Self. The editable graph exposes both frame runes, making these actions tutorials as well as shortcuts.
